mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, party_id, approved_time, draft_application_id, content_hash FROM t_party_profile WHERE party_id IN (SELECT party_id FROM t_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND current_slot = 1 ORDER BY profile_id
SELECT profile_id, party_id, approved_time, draft_application_id, content_hash FROM t_party_profile WHERE profile_id IN #{id} ORDER BY profile_id

SELECT f.profile_id AS profileId, f.party_id AS partyId, p.party_type AS partyType, f.approved_time AS approvedTime, f.draft_application_id AS draftApplicationId, f.content_hash AS contentHash, i.given_name AS givenName, i.middle_name AS middleName, i.family_name AS familyName, i.birth_date AS birthDate, i.nationality_country AS nationalityCountry, i.residence_country AS residenceCountry, o.legal_name AS legalName, o.incorporation_country AS incorporationCountry FROM t_party_profile f JOIN t_party p ON p.party_id = f.party_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = f.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = f.profile_id WHERE f.profile_id IN #{id} ORDER BY f.profile_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_party_profile SET approved_time=#{now,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, content_hash=#{contentHash}, draft_application_id=NULL, current_slot=1, update_time=#{now,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} WHERE party_id=#{partyId} AND current_slot=1 AND approved_time IS NULL
